specs.title: SCN-001: A guest creates an empty cart

steps.title: Given I am not signed in
When I POST /carts
Then the response status is 201
And the response contains the cart's id
And reading the cart lists no products

specs.title: SCN-002.1: Adding a product with a quantity on the limits of 1–99 (quantity 1)

steps.title: Given I created an empty cart
[SEED] guest cart
And a product that is in stock
[SEED] find 1 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
When I POST /carts/{id} with the product_id and quantity 1
Then the response status is 200
And the cart lists the product with quantity 1

specs.title: SCN-002.2: Adding a product with a quantity on the limits of 1–99 (quantity 99)

steps.title: Given I created an empty cart
[SEED] guest cart
And a product that is in stock
[SEED] find 1 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
When I POST /carts/{id} with the product_id and quantity 99
Then the response status is 200
And the cart lists the product with quantity 99

specs.title: SCN-003: Adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added

steps.title: Given I created a cart holding 2 of a product that is in stock
[SEED] find 1 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 2× Hammer
When I POST /carts/{id} with the same product_id and quantity 3
Then the cart lists the product once, with quantity 5

specs.title: SCN-004.1: A quantity just outside 1–99 is rejected and the cart is unchanged (quantity 0)

steps.title: Given I created a cart holding 1 of a product that is in stock
[SEED] find 2 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 1× Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip
And another product that is in stock
When I POST /carts/{id} with the other product's product_id and quantity 0
Then the response status is 422
And the response has an error for the quantity field
And the cart still lists only the first product, with quantity 1

specs.title: SCN-004.2: A quantity just outside 1–99 is rejected and the cart is unchanged (quantity 100)

steps.title: Given I created a cart holding 1 of a product that is in stock
[SEED] find 2 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 1× Pliers
And another product that is in stock
When I POST /carts/{id} with the other product's product_id and quantity 100
Then the response status is 422
And the response has an error for the quantity field
And the cart still lists only the first product, with quantity 1

specs.title: SCN-005: Adding a product from its product page shows the confirmation

steps.title: Given I am a guest with an empty cart
[SEED] find 1 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
And I am on the product page of a product that is in stock
When I choose quantity 3
And I press "Add to cart"
Then I see "Product added to shopping cart."

specs.title: SCN-006: The cart icon shows the total number of items after adding from the product page

steps.title: Given I am a guest with an empty cart
[SEED] find 1 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
And I am on the product page of a product that is in stock
When I choose quantity 3
And I press "Add to cart"
Then the cart icon in the navigation shows 3

specs.title: SCN-007: The cart page lists each product with quantity, unit price and line total

steps.title: Given I am a guest whose cart holds 2 of one in-stock product and 3 of another
[SEED] find 2 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 2× Hammer, 3× Claw Hammer
[SEED] put the guest cart into the browser
When I open the cart page (checkout step 1)
Then each product is listed with its quantity
And each product is listed with its unit price
And each product is listed with its line total, equal to price × quantity
And the cart total is shown

specs.title: SCN-008: The cart total equals the sum of the line totals

steps.title: Given I am a guest whose cart holds 2 of one in-stock product and 3 of another
[SEED] find 2 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 2× Bolt Cutters, 3× Slip Joint Pliers
[SEED] put the guest cart into the browser
When I open the cart page (checkout step 1)
Then the cart total equals the sum of the line totals

specs.title: SCN-009: Removing a product from the cart

steps.title: Given I created a cart holding 1 each of two products that are in stock
[SEED] find 2 in-stock product(s) (GET /products)
[SEED] guest cart with 1× Pliers, 1× Bolt Cutters
When I DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId} for the first product
Then the response status is 204
And the cart no longer lists the first product
And the cart still lists the second product
Given I created an empty cart
[SEED] guest cart
When I delete the cart
Then the response status is 204
